The failure is in `HashCodeBuilder`’s registry cleanup logic.

Static evidence:
- `getRegistry()` returns `REGISTRY.get()`.
- The thread-local `initialValue()` creates a new empty `HashSet<IDKey>`.
- `register(Object)` adds to that set.
- `unregister(Object)` only removes the `IDKey` from the set:
  ```java
  static void unregister(Object value) {

  }
  ```
- It never clears the `ThreadLocal` when the set becomes empty.

Why this causes the test failure:
- `testReflectionObjectCycle()` expects that after `a.hashCode()`, the temporary cycle-detection registry has been fully cleaned up, so `HashCodeBuilder.getRegistry()` should be `null`.
- Instead, because the thread-local remains initialized with an empty `HashSet`, `getRegistry()` returns `[]`, matching the assertion failure:
  `Expected: <null> but was: []`.

So the buggy method is `unregister(Object)`: it removes entries but does not remove/reset the thread-local when the registry becomes empty. The fix should make the registry fully cleared when the last element is unregistered.

m23.content:
The failure is in `HashCodeBuilder`’s registry cleanup logic.

Static evidence:
- `getRegistry()` returns `REGISTRY.get()`.
- The thread-local `initialValue()` creates a new empty `HashSet<IDKey>`.
- `register(Object)` adds to that set.
- `unregister(Object)` only removes the `IDKey` from the set:
  ```java
  static void unregister(Object value) {
      getRegistry().remove(new IDKey(value));
  }
  ```
- It never clears the `ThreadLocal` when the set becomes empty.

Why this causes the test failure:
- `testReflectionObjectCycle()` expects that after `a.hashCode()`, the temporary cycle-detection registry has been fully cleaned up, so `HashCodeBuilder.getRegistry()` should be `null`.
- Instead, because the thread-local remains initialized with an empty `HashSet`, `getRegistry()` returns `[]`, matching the assertion failure:
  `Expected: <null> but was: []`.

So the buggy method is `unregister(Object)`: it removes entries but does not remove/reset the thread-local when the registry becomes empty. The fix should make the registry fully cleared when the last element is unregistered.
